name: insightforge-ai
description: AI-powered, multi-tenant SaaS analytics platform for growing businesses.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names WEB,API,WORKER --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api --no-sync uvicorn --app-dir apps/api/src insightforge.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api --no-sync ruff check apps/api
scripts.format: npm run format:prettier && npm run format:api
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api --no-sync ruff format apps/api
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:prettier && uv run --project apps/api --no-sync ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.verify: npm run audit:content && npm run audit:secrets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
